name: Systems for Developer Interviews
description: Explain memory, concurrency, the kernel and the network, then write low-latency C++ for developer rounds.

lessonNames.l15-no-allocation: No allocation on the hot path

lessonObjectives.l1-latency-numbers: Order the costs of a register, cache, memory, disk and network access by powers of ten.
lessonObjectives.l2-caches: Predict cache misses from an access pattern and a line size.
lessonObjectives.l3-virtual-memory: Explain pages, the TLB and a page fault, and what each costs.
lessonObjectives.l4-object-layout: Work out a struct's size and padding, and reorder its fields to shrink it.
lessonObjectives.l5-branches: Explain branch prediction and remove a branch from a hot loop.
lessonObjectives.l6-threads: Say what threads share and what each one owns.
lessonObjectives.l7-data-races: Find a data race by stepping two threads through an interleaving.
lessonObjectives.l8-locks-and-deadlock: Protect shared data with a mutex and avoid deadlock by fixing the lock order.
lessonObjectives.l9-atomics: Use an atomic counter and say what each memory order guarantees.
lessonObjectives.l10-producer-consumer: Pass work between threads with a queue and a condition variable.
lessonObjectives.l11-processes: Explain a process, a system call and a context switch, and what each costs.
lessonObjectives.l12-files-and-sockets: Follow a read from a socket through the kernel into user space.
lessonObjectives.l13-tcp-and-udp: Choose between TCP, UDP and multicast for orders and for market data.
lessonObjectives.l14-messages-on-the-wire: Encode a market data message in a fixed binary layout and parse it back.
lessonObjectives.l15-no-allocation: Remove allocations from a hot path and write a pool allocator.
lessonObjectives.l16-ring-buffer: Build a fixed-size single-producer, single-consumer ring buffer.
lessonObjectives.l17-measuring-latency: Measure latency percentiles and say why the mean misleads.
lessonObjectives.l18-feed-handler: Design a market data handler end to end and defend each choice aloud.
